pageTitle: MAT Past Papers, Worked Solutions & Score Averages | Arij Asad
description: Historical Oxford MAT papers from 2007 to 2025, specimens and additional multiple-choice tests, with worked solutions, feedback and correctly labelled score averages.
intro: Oxford MAT papers and worked solutions for extra mathematical problem-solving and interview practice.
displayNotes: Oxford uses TMUA from 2026. MAT is no longer held; this is a historical practice archive.

The averages below are Oxford’s published scores for applicants to Mathematics, Mathematics & Statistics, and Mathematics & Philosophy. They are means out of 100, not grade boundaries or guaranteed interview or offer scores.

Older papers have different formats and course-specific question choices. Read each paper’s instructions and the linked syllabus notes. Specimens and additional tests have no comparable averages here.
